content.text: The project, valued at €160,242, exhibits significant specification gaps that threaten cost certainty and compliance. High-risk items (€7,552) include missing thermal insulation parameters, excavation details, and waterproofing classes, directly violating VOB/C § 4.2.1 and jeopardizing GEG compliance. Medium-risk issues (€10,137) involve unclear risk allocation for site preparation, undefined masonry and screed details, and unspecified waste disposal. Low-risk gaps (€1,886) affect paving, asphalt, and plastering. Total identified risk exposure is approximately €19,575 (12.2% of total value). Immediate action is required to clarify technical specifications, assign responsibilities, and define material standards to mitigate cost overruns and legal disputes before contract award.
